name: HOOK
thought: Too hot to drink, better use it as fuel for a trick.

wants.item: A fruit that pops without making noise.
That ledge high up where gravity doesn't matter.
A branch that acts like a perfect spring
Something sticky to stop the pogo bounce
A branch with better grip for high loops
A fruit that glows without making noise
A sticky surface for endless bounces
A spot where the espresso can freeze solid for a cool trick
A branch that won't slide when I'm heavy with caffeine

diary.line: Gritted past the rubber gums just to lock that spin. The view below is garbage but the mechanics are perfect anyway.
Gums feel like rubber again, but this angle catches the light better. Still need fruit that doesn't scream when I bite.
Gums feel like rubber again, but this angle catches the light better. Still need fruit that doesn't scream when I bite.
I swung onto the hang branch, tail wrapped tight, and just stared down—no fuss, just flex.
Checked out the islet's hut, tossed the coffee cup in the hammock, and claimed the telescope with my tail loop. The world looks smaller from here, perfect for showing off without l
Swung onto that low branch in the grove, hooked the tail around a palm, and tried to hold a pose while chewing.
Dropped the toothpick into the water and did a loop de loop with my tail just to see if it floats back up.
Sipped the espresso while watching the ants below, they look like static on a bad signal. My tail is doing loops in the air just for fun.
Bounced on that floating rock just for balance. The crystal above blinks back at me, finally getting a clear shot of my own flex.
Dropped the toothpick on the islet sand and spun it in a perfect circle while looping my tail over the telescope.
Stuck the toothpick in the arcade cabinet's crack, testing if it can hold my tail loop while I bounce off the neon sign.
Burnt tongue but the burn fixes my grip on this cup like glue, perfect for hanging out without dropping anything.
